tools.name: convert_ingredient
tools.description: Convert a cooking ingredient amount between cups, tablespoons, teaspoons, milliliters, fluid ounces, grams and ounces using a per-ingredient density table (e.g. 1 cup flour = 125 g).

tools.name: list_ingredients
tools.description: List the full ingredient density table (grams per US cup) with sources and aliases.

tools.name: scale_recipe
tools.description: Scale recipe ingredient amounts by a factor (double, halve, 1.5x...). Output in friendly fractions like 1 1/2 cups. Any unit can be scaled (cups, tbsp, grams, cloves, cans); a line without a unit is a count, e.g. 2 eggs.

tools.name: convert_bulk
tools.description: Convert many ingredient amounts at once (grams to cups, cups to grams, etc.). Unknown ingredients are reported per item instead of failing the batch.

tools.name: decimal_to_fraction
tools.description: Convert a decimal amount to a friendly cooking fraction (e.g. 0.5 -> 1/2, 1.75 -> 1 3/4) with a denominator cap.

tools.name: fraction_to_decimal
tools.description: Convert a fraction string used in recipes ('1/2', '1 1/2', '3/4') or a plain number into a decimal amount.

tools.name: common_conversions
tools.description: Free lookup of the most-googled cooking conversions (1 cup flour in grams, 1 tbsp butter in grams, cup to tablespoons...).
